messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager opened (Sev2) — suspicious auth header leak detected in analytics pipeline. Source: edge-log-forwarder. See /runbooks/auth-leak for checklist.

sre-oncall: seeing a 4.8% spike in 401s for prod - rolling window 5m. No customer tickets yet but increased error rate.

marta: copying logs — looks like upstream indexer forwarded raw headers to external bucket for 6m window. Confirming S3 bucket ACLs now.

jordan: tagging this for security & legal. I'll take over on-call in 15m. Current tasks: 1) block forwarder egress, 2) rotate svc account key, 3) start scrub job for exposed objects.

security: on it. Recommend immediate service-account key rotation + revoke any long-lived tokens referenced. Also prepare a minimal disclosure timeline.

legal: please publish the incident triage doc link and hold PR for customer notifications until we have confirmed scope. We need the list of potentially affected customers.

observability-bot: Metric alert -> auth.header.forward_count = 312 (5m). Correlation: high cardinality paths: /api/v1/generate and /internal/ingest.

marta: temp mitigation applied: firewall rule added to block forwarder host egress to external-bucket-host:9000. Verified traffic dropped to zero from that host.

jordan: rotation command (running now):
```bash
# rotate key for analytics-forwarder service account
aws iam list-access-keys --user analytics-forwarder || true
aws iam create-access-key --user analytics-forwarder
# update secrets manager and restart forwarder deployment
```

sre-oncall: scrub job started: running s3-list + redact script. Script will redact auth headers and then move objects to quarantine-bucket. ETA ~24h for full backlog, prioritizing last 6h window.

security: initiate short-lived creds for downstream jobs and set quantized access. We'll also push a policy to disable object public-read and rotate KMS key if bucket was encrypted.

jordan: customer impact note for SEs: no evidence of PII exfil yet, but sessions tokens may be present. Recommend proactive rotation for customers with automated external integrations — drafts to legal for review.

legal: acknowledged. Please attach a scoped list (tenant IDs) once scrub job completes for the last-6h window. We'll prepare comms templates.

marta: handing off to jordan (oncall) — I remain available for the scrub job and firewall follow-ups. 

jordan: taking over. Current status: forwarder egress blocked, key rotation in progress, scrub job running, legal looped. Next check-in in 20m. :lock:

incident-bot: Incident updated: Sev2 -> Active mitigation. Bridge: https://redwood.example/incident/1709283333. Pagers: @sre-oncall @jordan @security.

sre-oncall: quick note — metrics show error rate normalized to baseline after block. Will monitor error spikes and token reuse attempts.

security: will run a quick hunt for external access logs and add IOCs. If we find evidence of targeted exfil, escalate to Sev1 and notify customers immediately.

jordan: agreed. If anything new appears before next check-in ping here. Closing handoff message. :white_check_mark:
